priority_items.title: Cabinet endorses Criminal Records Regulations 2026; seasonal-worker clearances still destination-law
priority_items.summary: In-window FBC 15:04 FJT / 03:04 UTC: Cabinet endorsed Criminal Records Regulations 2026 to implement the Criminal Records Act 2026. Police clearances will account for spent/expunged records; prior adverse applicants must re-apply. Seasonal-worker travel still must comply with destination-country employment and immigration law. Separate in-window FBC 15:00 FJT: consultant-led NMW/10-sector wage review approved. Not a compact. Not FLASH.
